machine.title: The order lifecycle, and what it must never do

S1-no-delivery-without-charge.text: Never deliver an order that was never charged

S2-charged-implies-post-charge.text: Never mark an order charged before the charge step

L1-cancellable-until-charged.text: An order stays cancellable until it is charged (reachability — checked separately)

counterexample.title: Three steps to goods delivered and never paid for
counterexample.subtitle: One guard was removed: the check that stops an order shipping before its payment succeeds. Polygraph then tried every order of events the machine allows.
counterexample.violationDetail: The order reached DELIVERED while charged was still false. Each step on its own was permitted; the sequence is what breaks the rule.

callout.title: Nobody wrote this test.
callout.body: Polygraph explored every state the order can reach, found the one that breaks the rule, and returned the shortest way to get there. The path is executable, so it becomes a regression test.

compat.title: State outlives its code
compat.subtitle: The bug isn't in the new code. It's in the state the old code already left behind.
